title: BodyWrap 소재 #037 · pm porcelain · hourglass bombshell · 팔·몸통 밧줄 결박 · deep wine-red matte lip
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, mid 30s, Chang'e, the Chinese moon goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, half-up half-down copper red hair — full body glazed celadon porcelain fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid glazed porcelain curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted porcelain sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING soft jade-green celadon glaze with incised lotus and cloud patterns across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID darker green pooled glaze and fine crackle lines running between the sections, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, glossy glazed, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. She wears a heavy medieval iron neck ring of wide rough-forged wrought iron, closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, with a heavy iron ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Her upper arms are pressed against her sides and bound to her torso with many tight turns of thick natural jute rope with strands as thick as a finger and rough fibers visible, wound around her ribcage and upper arms from just below her bust down to her waist, tied off with a heavy knot at her back, her forearms and hands free below the rope. Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, outward to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the stone wall at hip height on its own side, her forearms angled slightly outward by the chains. Pose: standing full height between the two walls, facing the camera, her upper arms held against her sides, her forearms angled slightly outward by the chains, her feet shoulder-width apart, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of the same porcelain, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, made of the same porcelain with a high polish.
Jewelry: sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT porcelain — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Background: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM, solid material from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure completely visible. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.

poses: mid-stride runway walk toward the camera, shoulders back, one boot crossing in front of the other
